title: Install Board Game Design
lead: Markdown-first Agent Skill (v5.0.0). Works in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and any host that reads SKILL.md per the Agent Skills spec.
note: The folder name must match the skill name: board-game-design. Root SKILL.md must include YAML name and description fields.

cursor.title: Cursor
cursor.body: Clone into your skills directory. Prefer project scope when the game repo is shared.

claude.title: Claude Code
claude.body: Same layout under .claude/skills/. Use project scope when the game repo is shared.

codex.title: Codex
codex.body: Install under .agents/skills/, or use the Vercel skills CLI to symlink into Codex's skills directory.

prompt.title: Prompt checklist
items: Player count, duration, audience, target feel (MDA aesthetics)
New project or continuation (session 2+: say read design-state first)
For iteration: observed symptom and playtest evidence
For tests: one variable and a measurable success metric

example.title: Starter Create prompt
example.text:
Design a 2-4 player, 45-minute medium-weight game about Mars colony logistics.
Target feel: scarcity tension, long-term planning, light direct conflict.
Audience: hobby gamers who know Wingspan but not heavy euros.
Compare worker placement vs action drafting vs open market. Recommend one with trade-offs.
Write concept-brief, design-state, and mechanism-skeleton to ./mars-habitat/ using templates/examples/micro-scavenger/ as format reference.
Do not write full rules yet.

runtime.title: Optional sim runtime (bgd-sim)
runtime.body: Not required for design modes. After cloning the repo:
runtime.command:
pip install -e ./runtime
bgd-sim run --game micro-scavenger --runs 1000 --seed 42 --population mixed --out sim.json
